method: Static PE facts, Rizin call-path review, resource extraction, bounded native arithmetic emulation and pure CIL data interpretation. No sample application or network payload was executed.
external_evidence: The three supplied tria.ge pages were inaccessible. ML and sandbox scores were not treated as proof.

samples.marker_content: StormAttack DLL injector: confirmed persistence and cleanup; no change
identification_and_evidence: Rizin: entry 0x402674 calls dispatch 0x401cb0. Mode at 0x404120 is 3; 0x401f75 selects Active Setup installation 0x401900 and cleanup 0x401390.

0x401900 obtains its module path, constructs HKLM Active Setup Installed Components GUID key, writes StubPath at 0x401a4b, reads its own image with CRT I/O, patches mode/path bytes, writes a copy and launches it at 0x401b7e.

0x401150 creates an IE/notepad/calc process; VirtualAllocEx and WriteProcessMemory place a DLL path remotely. GetProcAddress resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA; CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d receives that export and the remote path.

0x401260 replaces LanmanServer Parameters ServiceDLL at 0x40133e. 0x402460 requests DLL resource 101 and its helper writes resource bytes. The present .rsrc is entirely zero; no working embedded DLL or successful installation is asserted.
0x401390 obtains module/short path and COMSPEC, constructs cmd /c del for itself and starts that shell.

PKCS#7 signer cryptography verifies but both Authenticode image digests mismatch. Microsoft certificate names establish no Microsoft provenance for this image. Certificate URLs and a percent-decoded printf GUID format establish no C2 or URL obfuscation.
No WannaCry, ransomware or functional DDoS behavior was established.

samples.marker_content: .NET Reactor protected app: remove unsupported hostile loader claims
identification_and_evidence: Identified a native .NET Reactor protection wrapper and a protected task-based managed application; no original product/publisher identity or concrete hostile action was established. BENIGN follows the requested thin-evidence threshold, not a claim that every protected feature is understood.

Native entry calls main 0x4019f0. IsDebuggerPresent is in CRT exception machinery, not the alleged hostile staging gate. Pure instruction emulation recovers Cor_Enable_Profiling, mscorjit.dll, clrjit.dll, __, mscoree.dll and CLRCreateInstance from the 32-byte unrolled XOR decoder 0x401650.

Resource RT_RCDATA/__ at RVA 0x2613c is 1,937,627 bytes. Pure emulation of 0x401300 builds the substitution tables; 0x401560 performs forward/reverse adjacent-byte feedback in 1024-byte blocks. Reproduced decoding yields a four-byte size 2,825,742 then a checksum-valid zlib stream. Its output begins with a 14-byte CLR version prefix followed by a 2,825,728-byte PE.

Native 0x402171 resolves CLRCreateInstance and the subsequent metahost/runtime/AppDomain COM calls load the decoded assembly. Its managed method ___ reads resource _, Assembly.Loads its bytes, obtains EntryPoint and invokes it, forwarding command-line arguments. This is ordinary protector bootstrap behavior, with no required remote tasking or theft.

Extracted resource _ is 2,819,584 bytes. Its Reactor initializer LDFgNmI4H (method 2254, RVA 0xb1f74) is flattened arithmetic control flow. A bounded CIL interpreter, with no OS or program execution, recovers the 65,892-byte method-patch resource; its key mixes public-key token 461d39c4a423da0b. Parsed the whole stream and restored 2,610 prefix/header patch records.

Pure interpretation of the proxy initializer (method 2245, RVA 0xb1470) decrypts 13,200 bytes into 1,650 field-to-method mappings. Entry method 680 reaches method 833, whose loop starts/waits a task list. The entry cctor schedules methods 686-689; resolved paths register an unhandled-exception handler, inspect application/assembly locations and initialize further tasks.

Recovered metadata includes networking, process and desktop APIs. Such capabilities, protection checks and remaining encrypted strings do not establish spying, theft, a backdoor or deceptive execution. No attribution to the collector filename families is justified.
Final raw-sample coverage: zero hostile and one suspicious custom resource-concealment finding. The opaque string table is a remaining analysis limit.

samples.marker_content: Urelas MSMP loader: detect Run write; consolidate family profiles
identification_and_evidence: Identified the Urelas MSMP-state network loader by independently traced state validation, adapter-based request construction, resource handling, executable launch and logon persistence. No filename family label was used as behavioral proof.

Native CRT entry 0x40c85b reaches main 0x401081. 0x401955 installs/copies executable data and writes HKCU Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows Run. 0x402207 ShellExecutes the path; 0x402227 opens the Windows key and 0x402250 writes the same path as REG_SZ Run, with a computed UTF-16 length.

0x402432 obtains an encrypted ZIP resource through 0x402974 and invokes extraction via 0x402278, then launches the resulting temporary executable at 0x4025e6. The separate TrayKey write at 0x402627 is coordination/configuration, not itself logon persistence.

IDR_BINARY/131 is a traditional encrypted ZIP. Password 1234 extracts HanAgent_pe.exe with CRC verification: 228,352 bytes, SHA256 0742a171ff4693bb30cd153ca77039b1012b867ed7fa4aef30be00526ee55678. The payload is PECompact-packed; its entry 0x41207a installs an SEH unpacking handler. No operational surveillance claim is based solely on the packed payload or its name.

0x408b07 reads 512-byte state through golfset/golfinfo helpers, complements every byte and checks MSMP. 0x408b93 serializes/complements matching state. 0x402b08 enumerates local adapters. 0x40841e sends a 512-byte record with command 3001; 0x408656 uses command 3002 to request a file, receives it through 0x404ee0 and writes the received bytes.

0x403612 maps the system volume to a physical disk via IOCTL_VOLUME_GET_VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS and 0x4032f2 opens PhysicalDrive. 0x403542 reads sectors, checks _GBP and extracts hidden configuration. No linked disk overwrite or MBR installation was established; none is claimed.
0x403141 writes a retry-until-gone self-delete batch to temp and ShellExecutes it. Existing resource/launch and disk-path co-occurrence traits remain neutral.
Final raw-sample coverage: one family identity and one independently matched logon-persistence objective; no duplicate hostile disk-path identity.

changes: Replaced the generic hostile opaque-resource/CLR profile with a neutral capability profile plus a suspicious detector requiring the verified table-feedback decoder and CLR hosting identifiers.
Retired unsigned CLR anti-debug stager and dominant-section duplicates. An IsDebuggerPresent import does not establish an anti-debug gate; the largest section was resource data, not code.
Moved the MSMP immediate comparison from family identity to binary instruction metadata, preserving its scope and matcher. Consolidated the two Urelas identities and updated Elex suppressors.

Added a generalizable PE-aware Windows Run-write capability that follows the pushed key/value pointers and shared HKEY stack slot, plus a hostile complemented-state network-loader persistence composite.
Moved the generic high-entropy writable-entry/few-import profile to neutral section-header metadata; packing alone is not hostile.

Moved the Windows Script Settings key reference out of registry/write into keys/policy, preserving its matcher and scope and updating its exact consumer. This is also the reviewed misplaced-rule correction that keeps registry/write within its budget.
Renamed HGDraw/golfinfo descriptions to state name references without inferring screen capture.
placement_and_consumers: No new taxonomy directories were created. Exact retired IDs have no remaining YAML consumers.
The registry/write ancestor consumer is the SilentCleanup UAC composite: a bare WSH key reference must not satisfy its write leg. No keys/policy directory consumer was found.

The relocated packing profile was in three metadata suppression selectors. These are updated to include its new exact ID, preserving their prior population without admitting unrelated destination members.

The two complexity suppressors use the existing short-or-high-entropy-string-population OR composite, whose four members exactly equal their previous four explicit suppressors; this preserves the set and stays within suppression budgets.
supplementary_checks: Extracted PECompact HanAgent payload has no hostile/suspicious findings after correcting the packing-only rule; the relocated neutral packing profile remains.
WSH path-only JavaScript matches the relocated keys/policy reference. This atom claims no registry write.
